annotations.title: Get a 3D Studio link for a project

description: Returns a link that opens one of the signed-in person's Drint projects in Drint, ready to hand on to Drint 3D Studio, where its whole product set is staged and rendered as photo-real scenes that come back to the project's review inbox. The person finishes the hand-on in Drint (the products and their artwork are built in their browser), so this tool sends nothing by itself. Take the id from list_my_projects.

lang.description: The user's language (vi, en, th, zh…). Default en.

name: send_to_3d_studio
